message.subject: ISA 2026 + complete solution positioning
message.body:
Hi [Name],

Saw Epson's messaging around same-day lamination for vehicle wraps—smart positioning against Roland and HP.

Curious if you're exploring protective film partnerships to strengthen that story. We work with printer manufacturers whose customers need graffiti-resistant, weather-durable overlaminates for outdoor graphics. Helps reduce those warranty headaches when prints fail prematurely, even though the ink and printer performed perfectly.

With ISA coming up, might be worth a quick conversation about how other teams are positioning complete solutions versus just equipment. Happy to share what's working.

Worth a chat?

Best,
[Your name]

personalization_used.hook: Epson markets same-day lamination and scratch resistance for vehicle wraps, but lacks a validated protective film partner to substantiate these durability claims
personalization_used.value_prop_emphasized: Graffiti resistance and weather durability that prevents warranty claims and strengthens competitive positioning
